grh_fa6a7061c99c65900b2f.title: The Duke of Nevers
paragraphs: In 1885 San Francisco, wealthy Harry Penrod is alarmed when his daughter Gertie returns from Europe married to Charles Jules Francois, a penniless Frenchman who calls himself the Duke de Nevers and commander of the Legion of Honor. Charles lives by an elaborate code of aristocratic honor, refuses an offered business partnership and never touches a large sum Mrs. Penrod places within his reach. His downfall comes when he tries to help a young couple by pledging property he does not own as bail, leading to his arrest for false statements and fraud. Investigation shows the historic Nevers line has been extinct for generations, and Charles privately admits to Gertie that he was born poor in Paris and married her under false pretenses. Sentenced to five years at hard labor, he nevertheless refuses to abandon the noble identity he has created for himself, insisting to the end that he is the Duke de Nevers.

grh_fa0a7374a3e46c415a45.title: The Hard Way
paragraphs: Trying to go straight, Harry accepts $1,000 to fly a wealthy man's troublesome young niece to a finishing school in Switzerland. The girl secretly turns the trip into a kidnapping scheme of her own, hoping Harry will demand a huge ransom from her uncle so she can take the money and marry her fiancé. Harry wants no part of the plan and lands at the remote farm of his old associate Mo while deciding what to do. Mo mistakes the situation for a real abduction and is horrified that Harry has broken his promise to stay legitimate. Harry returns the girl to her uncle, who is determined to get her safely to school. The episode ends with one final complication: during her stay at the farm she stole $60,000 of counterfeit money from Mo.
